name: tx_regform
x87_stkflt_note: R2-H06: this program drives the x87 stack past its ends. QEMU implements no stack faults, so the differential masks fstat IE|SF|C1|C0|C2|C3 (0x4741 -- the #IS response has no QEMU counterpart; C1 is the direction bit and C0/C2/C3 are implementation-defined per SDM Vol.1 Table 8-4) and the st* QNaN-indefinite substitution. The behavior itself is gated architecturally by px87stk.
x87_stkflt_ranges_note: The masks are the EXACT measured divergence set of an unmasked compare vs the pinned-QEMU golden (35 records, n=0..34): the 9th/10th pushes (fld1 at n=15, fldl2e at n=16) overflow the full stack, so from n=16 the QNaN-indefinite substitution propagates through FSCALE/the FCOMs/the pops exactly as listed (fstat IE|SF plus the FCOM condition codes C0..C3 at n=20..23 -- all inside 0x4741), and n=24..25 are the resync refill overwriting the last substituted physical slot. Records n=26..34 (seven refill pushes, exit) compare with ZERO masks. Everything outside the listed records/fields -- fstat AND st0..st7 -- compares at full strength.
